question:
Select the correct option to substitute the given set of words.

a statement open to more than one interpretation
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ambiguous"** means something that is open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** The instructions he gave were ***ambiguous***, so no one knew exactly what to do.
 
 
 
• Explanation: The word ***"ambiguous***" is used to describe a statement or situation that can be understood in multiple ways. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** The ending of the movie is ***ambiguous***, leaving the audience to interpret what happened.
 
 

Therefore, the correct substitution of the given statement is '**ambiguous**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Explicit** (स्पष्ट): Stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.

 
 
• **Example:** The rules were ***explicit***, so everyone understood what was expected of them.
 
 
 
• **Palpable** (स्पष्ट): Able to be touched or felt; so intense as to seem almost tangible.
 
 
• **Example:** The tension in the room was ***palpable*** as the results were announced.
 
 
 
• **Tangible** (ठोस): Perceptible by touch; clear and definite; real.
 
 
• **Example:** The benefits of the new policy are*** tangible*** and measurable.
